events.command:
KEY=$(cat $GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE)
WORKING="bbd44e69cb8906b5f1a5dc97941f980a"

# Download full per-feature output and verify counts
curl -s "https://usegalaxy.org/api/histories/$WORKING/contents/f9cad7b01a472135f638eab339d39cf1/display" \
  -H "x-api-key: $KEY" | python3 -c "
import sys
header = sys.stdin.readline()
lines = sys.stdin.readlines()
total = len(lines)
sig = sum(1 for l in lines if l.strip().endswith('true'))
print(f'Total features: {total}')
print(f'Significant: {sig}')
print(f'Percentage: {sig/total*100:.4f}%')

# Verify BH correction looks reasonable
print()
print('First 5 significant genes:')
sig_genes = [l for l in lines if l.strip().endswith('true')]
for l in sig_genes[:5]:
    parts = l.strip().split('\t')
    print(f'  {parts[0]}: ρ={float(parts[2]):.4f}, p={float(parts[3]):.2e}, p_bh={float(parts[4]):.2e}')

# Check range of p-values and BH-adjusted
import math
pvals = [float(l.strip().split('\t')[3]) for l in lines if len(l.strip().split('\t')) == 6]
padjs = [float(l.strip().split('\t')[4]) for l in lines if len(l.strip().split('\t')) == 6]
print(f'\nP-value range: {min(pvals):.2e} to {max(pvals):.4f}')
print(f'BH-adjusted p-value range: {min(padjs):.2e} to {max(padjs):.4f}')
"
